'''Ngbee''' is an extinct [[Bantu language]] of uncertain affiliation. Guthrie assigned to the [[Nyali languages|Nyali]] cluster,<ref name="Guthrie"/> ''Ethnologue'' classifies it as a [[Nyali language]].<ref name=e25/> ''Glottolog'' places it near the [[Ngendan languages]].
